en: The postcard's front features a black-and-white photograph of a pier or quay covered in thick ice and snow, with dramatic icicles encasing railings, structures, and two tall utility poles. The environment appears extremely cold, likely after a winter storm by the sea. The back of the postcard has handwritten Cyrillic text, a Bulgarian postage stamp, postal markings, and a purple stamp with the name 'Ярослав В. Гочев' and 'Варна'.
